input.behavior_to_protect: When both a parent class and a child class are registered, resolving for the child must return the child's handler regardless of registration order.

description: Write one regression scenario where both a parent class and a child class are registered; resolving for the child must return the child's handler regardless of registration order. The scenario must fail a mutant that walks registered classes in insertion order.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
